notablePrerequisites: All modes but "Abandon Ship" have been chosen for Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
easyPrerequisites:
Stiltzkin does not have summoning sickness.
There is at least one card in your library.
description:
Activate Stiltzkin by paying {2} and tapping it, drawing a card and causing target opponent to gain control of Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
At the beginning of that opponent's upkeep, they are forced to choose the "Abandon Ship" mode and lose the game.
